Brookfield Asset Management Inc increased its stake in Atmos Energy Corp (ATO) by 64.4% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Brookfield Asset Management Inc bought 291,800 shares as the company’s stock rose 6.76% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 744,900 shares of the oil and gas transmission company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $62.75M, up from 453,100 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Brookfield Asset Management Inc who had been investing in Atmos Energy Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $9.48 billion market cap company.
